## Evidence
At main `3c63d77db174de9e4adaf54ad13b3c28d5513c24`, Daily Release [job 126708141984](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/actions/runs/41817236819/job/126708141984) successfully approved three PR319 workflow runs at 16:44:43–44 UTC on 2026-11-04. At 17:14:25 it nevertheless failed with “its CI run is awaiting workflow approval” and instructed a maintainer to approve. The immediately preceding status was BLOCKED, settling `lifecycle, codeql`, failing none.

[Workflow source](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/3c63d77db174de9e4adaf54ad13b3c28d5513c24/.github/workflows/release.yml#L485-L624) initializes `awaiting_approval=0` outside the loop, sets it to 1 after any pending-run observation even when approval succeeds, and never clears/recomputes it. The timeout branch therefore treats historical approval as current. An isolated Bash probe of that exact timeout branch with a prior successful approval and then empty `pending_runs` reproduces the misleading instruction; no GitHub mutations or release workflow were run by this review.

## Goal, impact and expected behavior
[Canonical pmc-blj6](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/3c63d77db174de9e4adaf54ad13b3c28d5513c24/.agents/pm/issues/pmc-blj6.toon) explicitly aims to distinguish pending approval from failed/missing checks in timeout diagnostics. Expected: report current approval state or the actual unresolved checks, without asking for already-completed approval. Actual: a sticky flag masks the current blocker and sends operators toward an ineffective action. This is a diagnostics defect, not evidence that approval caused the timeout or that publication protections were bypassed.

## Acceptance and regression criteria
- Recompute current pending approvals and account for successful approvals before timeout reporting.
- Test pending→approved→running/queued→timeout, genuine pending approval at timeout, and no-approval check timeout.
- Preserve exact-head merge checks, fail-closed publication, existing protections and timeout budget.
- If fresh state cannot be obtained, report uncertainty instead of asserting pending approval.

## Deduplication and limits
Checked all 318 all-status issue/PR entries and 211 canonical records at the tested commit. Closed PR137/pmc-blj6 covers earlier merge-wait hardening, not this stale-state residual. Related same-pattern reports exist in pm-jev89 and pm-ts-starter191; this issue tracks the affected pm-changelog copy. Full hosted log and exact static control flow support this report; no full local suite or provider execution was performed.
